name: Repo::worktree_add_and_remove

test_list.description: A validated branch and revision produce an isolated linked worktree.
Git rejects duplicate branch and nonexistent revision requests without escape.
A dirty checkout is preserved unless the caller explicitly forces removal.
Successful removal updates the lifecycle handle and removes the checkout.
Common repository filters and includes are checked for linked worktrees.

output_description: A linked checkout confined under the repository's Polaris worktree directory.
